result_text:
A sub-landscape without a readable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent report. Its row now renders with the link to its index page and the default landscape logo. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add one for the missing-config case.

The fix is one line in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in the sub-landscapes table loop (around line 653). `getSubLandscapeConfig` already catches the read error and returns `null`, which caused the `NullPointerException`. The caller now falls back to an empty `Metadata` when the config, or its metadata, is `null`. With no logo set, the existing code picks the default logo. Rows whose config reads fine still show their own logo.
